role: The shapeless recipe: an unordered ingredient list matched by consuming one grid stack per ingredient, item identity plus damage (wildcard 32767 takes any).
scope_reason: Shapeless recipes (flint and steel, dyes, buckets and more) are part of the recipe list the crafting gate replays; no switch touches them.

members.name: ShapelessRecipes
members.note: Constructor state is flattened into the generated struct recipe_def (kind RECIPE_SHAPELESS, size, ingredient run, output).

members.name: recipeItems
members.note: The ingredient list is a run in the flat RECIPE_ITEMS table.

members.name: getRecipeOutput
members.note: A field read; the native caller reads recipe_def.output directly.

members.name: matches
members.note: Each grid stack consumes one ingredient of the same item and damage (wildcard takes any); every ingredient must be consumed. Java scans the grid slots; native walks the same order.

members.name: getCraftingResult
members.note: Just a copy of the output; the native caller copies recipe_def.output in the shared result path.

notes: Java's matches mutates a copy of the ingredient list while scanning; the native matcher keeps the same consumption order so results agree, which the 40,000-grid probe checks. Did not verify a named native symbol for the copy in getCraftingResult; it is the shared output path of craft_find_matching.
